image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a wombat sitting on a bed of dry leaves and twigs. The animal has a robust, barrel-shaped body covered in coarse, dark grey/brown fur. Its head is tucked down or obscured by the angle, making facial features difficult to discern clearly. One hind leg and foot are visible, showing short, powerful limbs. The tail is not visible. The background consists of natural ground cover.
